list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Trimer with a planar Yb3F3 ring; the Yb–F bond lengths are nearly equal.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of [YbCp2(DME)] and perfluoro(methylcyclohexane) in DME was stirred in a biphasic system at room temperature for 48 h. The precipitate was filtered, washed twice with DME, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.time: Reaction: 48 h; crystals obtained after 3 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Biphasic reaction; saturated DME solution for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate was filtered, washed twice with DME (3 mL), dried under vacuum for 3 h (45% yield). A saturated DME solution stored at −20 °C for 3 weeks gave yellow crystals suitable for X-ray crystallography.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Eight-coordinate tetramer with a puckered Yb4F4 ring; F–Yb–F angles are about 90° and the two reported Yb–F–Yb angles are 178.9(4)° and 168.4(3)°.

synthesis.procedure: [Yb(MeCp)2(THF)] and perfluorodecalin were combined with DME; the emerald-green biphasic mixture was stirred at room temperature for 24 h. The precipitated orange solid was filtered, washed with DME, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Orange solid precipitated after 2 h, was filtered off, washed twice with DME (0.5 mL), and dried under vacuum for 3 h (25% yield). Single crystals for X-ray analysis were obtained by isothermal evaporation of DME in a U-tube, with one arm at room temperature and the other cooled in liquid nitrogen.

title: Syntheses and Structures of Bis(aryloxo)fluoroytterbium(III) Complexes, [Yb(OAr)2F(THF)]2 (OAr = OC6H2-2,6-tBu2-4-R; R = H, Me, tBu), and Bis(cyclopentadienyl)fluoroytterbium(III) Complexes, [YbCp2F]3, [Yb(MeCp)2F]4, [YbCp2F(OPPh3)]2, and [Yb(MeCp)2F(THF)]2
